name: customer-story-page
title: Customer story page
description: Customer story layout with a back link, title, date, and article column.
usage: The page for one customer story (or a case study), followed by the closing call to action. Put the story's prose (the blog's article body) in as children; the dot field goes in `backdrop`.
avoid: A dark hero band on a story page

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
